original_query: with inv as (select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy        ,stdev,mean, case mean when 0 then null else stdev/mean end cov  from(select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy             ,stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) stdev,avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) mean       from inventory           ,item           ,warehouse           ,date_dim       where inv_item_sk = i_item_sk         and inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk         and inv_date_sk = d_date_sk         and d_year =1998         and i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')         and i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 and 47         and inv_quantity_on_hand between 225 and 425       group by w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy) foo  where case mean when 0 then 0 else stdev/mean end > 1) select inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean, inv1.cov         ,inv2.w_warehouse_sk,inv2.i_item_sk,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov from inv inv1,inv inv2 where inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk   and inv1.w_warehouse_sk =  inv2.w_warehouse_sk   and inv1.d_moy=2   and inv2.d_moy=2+1   and inv1.cov > 1.5 order by inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean,inv1.cov         ,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov ;
rewritten_query:
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        i.i_item_sk,
        stddev_samp(CASE WHEN d.d_moy = 2 THEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand END) AS stdev_m2,
        avg(CASE WHEN d.d_moy = 2 THEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand END) AS mean_m2,
        stddev_samp(CASE WHEN d.d_moy = 3 THEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand END) AS stdev_m3,
        avg(CASE WHEN d.d_moy = 3 THEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand END) AS mean_m3
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 1998
      AND d.d_moy IN (2, 3)
      AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 47
      AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 225 AND 425
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, i.i_item_sk
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        w_warehouse_sk,
        i_item_sk,
        mean_m2,
        mean_m3,
        CASE WHEN mean_m2 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev_m2 / mean_m2 END AS cov_m2,
        CASE WHEN mean_m3 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev_m3 / mean_m3 END AS cov_m3
    FROM stats
)
SELECT
    w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, 2 AS d_moy, mean_m2 AS mean, cov_m2 AS cov,
    w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, 3 AS d_moy, mean_m3 AS mean, cov_m3 AS cov
FROM filtered
WHERE cov_m2 > 1.5
  AND cov_m3 > 1
ORDER BY w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, mean_m2, cov_m2, mean_m3, cov_m3;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Push the d_moy filters (2 and 3) into the aggregation instead of computing statistics for all 12 months of 1998; only months 2 and 3 are needed by the final self-join. Also remove the unused w_warehouse_name from the GROUP BY key (functionally dependent on w_warehouse_sk primary key).

Eliminate the CTE self-join (inv1/inv2) by replacing it with conditional aggregation: compute month-2 and month-3 statistics in a single grouping pass, avoiding CTE materialization and a second scan of the aggregated result.

Replace implicit comma joins with explicit ANSI JOIN syntax and fold constant expressions (inv2.d_moy = 2+1 becomes 3; d_moy output constants 2 and 3). The cov > 1 CTE filter is subsumed by cov_m2 > 1.5 and cov_m3 > 1 in the final predicate.
The warehouse join is kept only to guarantee referential existence of w_warehouse_sk, but the unused w_warehouse_name column is dropped, shrinking the grouping key and the hash aggregate width.
